ideas.pitch: A privacy-preserving, zero-knowledge verifiable credential bridge for offline and low-bandwidth national ID verification in remote regions.
ideas.title: MOSIP-Bridge Credential Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with MOSIP's guiding principles of privacy, security, and scalability while solving a concrete edge case for countries with intermittent internet infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance and anomaly detection agent for national ID partner integrations to flag security and privacy leak risks pre-deployment.
ideas.title: ID-Audit Guard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines rigorous governance with modern AI agents, reflecting a pattern seen in winning compliance and auditing hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized consent and proxy management portal allowing family members to securely manage digital identity attributes for dependents within MOSIP ecosystems.
ideas.title: Biometric Proxy Consent Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a real inclusion challenge faced by diverse populations adopting foundational digital ID systems globally.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight edge synchronization daemon enabling local registration centers to queue and securely sync offline biometric updates to central MOSIP servers.
ideas.title: MOSIP Offline Sync Daemon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on hard systems engineering and distributed data reliability rather than just a superficial wrapper UI.

ideas.pitch: A modular configuration engine that lets local system integrators visually map country-specific identity attributes to MOSIP's core schemas without custom code.
ideas.title: Multi-Tenant ID Customizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core hackathon mission statement regarding the diverse customization needs of countries adopting MOSIP.
